integrity: Exact conditional-survival and moment log-convexity proof; code provides independently checkable finite rational tests and a Brownian example but is not an infinite-case certificate.
scientific_limitations: Identically distributed, independent, fully renewed searchers and identical independent group-clock laws. In the Brownian case positive diffusivity, distance, and Poisson rate are assumed. Does not compare arbitrary incomparable partitions or distinct group reset rates, and does not optimize resetting rate. Independent external priority and validation checks have not occurred.
title: A sharp partition-majorization law for grouped Brownian reset search
